findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk associated with long-term use of the same cryptographic key material and weakens the ability to limit blast radius if the key is ever compromised.

No key policy is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy that grants full access (kms:*) to the root account and effectively allows any IAM principal with appropriate IAM permissions in the account to use or manage the key, rather than restricting usage to specific roles/services such as the logging service that needs it.
